description: This file provides functionality for second level submenu navigation in a Drupal theme, including toggling submenus, handling events like hover, click, blur, and closing menus.

methods.name: toggleSubNav
methods.description: Shows or hides the second level submenu for a given menu item, updating ARIA attributes and classes.

methods.name: handleBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event to close submenu if focus moves outside the menu.

methods.name: closeAllSubNav
methods.description: Closes all second level sub navigation menus.

methods.name: areAnySubNavsOpen
methods.description: Checks if any sub navigation menus are currently open.
